principle: dev, staging and prod differ only in identity: project ids, credentials, endpoints, provider account ids and local test tooling. Which features exist must be identical. A feature gate may differ between environments only through one unexpired allowedDifferences entry naming its owner, expiry and Linear ticket.

classes.identity: Environment identity, credentials, provider account ids, endpoints, secret version references and local test tooling. Values may differ and are fingerprinted, never printed.
classes.feature-gate: Decides whether a feature or behavior exists. Must be identical in every environment unless an allowedDifferences entry applies.
classes.release-state: Per-environment release bookkeeping such as force-update floors and store listing URLs. Values may differ and are printed.
classes.retired: A removed switch. It may not reappear in source, the Remote Config template or a workflow outside its allowedIn sources; live leftovers are reported for cleanup.

allowedDifferences.reason: Instagram claim verification goes live in dev first. Meta sends webhooks to one callback URL at a time, and until App Review only accounts with a role on the Meta app can message through the API, so dev is switched on for testing before staging and prod.
